text:
Dylan Strome is doing what Dylan Strome does: 12 assists in 16 games, a pass-first center whose wingers get the goals. His ice time is up two minutes a night over his last ten, and his points per 60 (3.23) are running ahead of our range.

The finishing has been short. Three goals on 5.2 expected is the kind of gap that usually closes, so the goals should come. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 98th percentile among forwards for primary shot assists last season, and he carries the puck in more than half the time.

The cost is at the other end, and it's not new. Evolving-Hockey had opponents' chances rising with him on last season (bottom 4% of forwards), and the Capitals are a little worse at five on five with him than without. Our range has him at 55 to 79 points.
